items.title: Harry Shields Interview, 1961-05-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] No, it was on Franklin Street, right? Right in back of Lula White's. Was it? [INTERVIEWEE] Second block back, yeah.

ctx.x: No, it was in the district. ...of Rampart Street?
No, it was on Franklin Street, right? Right in back of Lula White's. Was it?
Second block back, yeah. Well, I heard he mentioned that name, the old tuxedo. And that he played there. He played there, yeah.
